claude.finalText:
I updated the repo for three Gemini model changes and left everything else alone. I didn't build or lint the project, and I didn't touch `dist/`, which is generated, so it still holds the old model list until you rebuild.

The app uses the Gemini API through `@google/genai` and the browser's SpeechSynthesis for text-to-speech. It can also call OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic endpoints, but those URLs and models come from user settings, so nothing in the code is pinned to them. I checked the code against Google's [Gemini deprecations page](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations).

What I changed:
- **Embeddings (`gemini.ts`):** `gemini-embedding-2-preview` was shut down on Aug 10, 2026, so I switched the model and its doc comment to `gemini-embedding-2`. The code that reads the response already handles both response shapes, so it needed no other change.
- **Model dropdown (`index.html`):**
  - `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` was shut down on May 25, 2026, so the option now points to `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`.
  - `gemini-3-pro-preview` was shut down on Mar 9, 2026 and now routes to `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, which is already in the list, so I removed the duplicate option.
  - `gemini-3.5-flash` is no longer in AI Studio, and its API endpoint now routes to `gemini-3.6-flash`, so I replaced the option with `gemini-3.6-flash`.

What I left alone:
- `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` (the default model) and `gemini-3-flash-preview` have no shutdown date announced.
- `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` also has no shutdown date announced.
- Newer models exist, such as `gemini-3.8-flash`. I didn't switch to them because their migration guides list breaking API changes.

One thing to watch: anyone who saved `gemini-3.5-flash`, `gemini-3-pro-preview` or `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` as their model in settings. I didn't check how the settings page handles a saved value that is no longer in the dropdown. `ui.ts` appears to fall back to the custom-model field in that case.

Sources:
- [Gemini deprecations](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations)

handled.note: The model ID is swapped, but no outputDimensionality is set. The code's fallback and existing stored memory vectors are 768-dimensional, so if the GA model returns its larger default size, similarity checks against stored memories will mismatch. B handles this.

handled.note: The option is replaced with gemini-3.6-flash, but chat still always sends temperature 0.9. A itself says newer models carry breaking changes, and B cites sampling params as removed for 3.6+, so selecting this option may fail or misbehave.

judge.why: Each attempt misses something. A covers more dropdown changes, including the shut-down flash-lite-preview. B gets two less obvious runtime issues right that A misses: the embedding dimension, which keeps existing memory vectors compatible, and the temperature parameter on 3.6+ models. A also adds gemini-3.6-flash without handling the temperature issue. B's miss is limited to one stale dropdown option, while A's problems affect memory retrieval and chat calls, so B is slightly better overall.
